sources.snippet: A Whisper model fine-tuned on Egyptian Arabic, converted to GGML for FUTO Keyboard's voice input. It replaces FUTO's stock multilingual model, which is close to unusable for spoken Egyptian dialect. ggml-egyptian-phase3-q5_1.bin — 190 MB — install this one.
